name: Wingsuit companion module
description: Drupal side of the Wingsuit front-end/design-system toolkit: a read-only ws-assets:// stream wrapper exposing a front-end build to Drupal, plus submodules that bridge the build to UI Patterns, Layout Builder, link attributes and Page Manager.
project_description: Companion module for Wingsuit. With Wingsuit you develop UI Patterns and/or Twig components in a front-end project (with Storybook and hot reloading) and use them in Drupal without mapping code. The main module registers a read-only ws-assets:// stream wrapper pointing at the built dist directory. Submodules: wingsuit_ui_patterns (UI Patterns deriver for *.wingsuit.yml patterns plus Twig functions), wingsuit_link (expose pattern settings as link attributes), wingsuit_lb (Layout Builder browser UI), wingsuit_page_manager (theme negotiator for Page Manager layout-builder steps).
